Reason for Mistake: The agent made a logical error in connecting the city's namesake to a landmark building. After correctly identifying the city as Duluth (named after Daniel Greysolon, Sieur du Lhut) in Step 1, the agent incorrectly assumed in Step 2 that the John Hancock Center was the relevant landmark because of a tenuous connection to "Hancock, Michigan." This was a failure to verify the actual namesake of the John Hancock Center (John Hancock) against the namesake of the city in the APOD (Du Lhut). The agent hallucinated a connection between the two entities to force a solution, rather than searching for a building actually named after Du Lhut or correctly identifying that no such building exists under that specific constraint, leading to a flawed reasoning chain.
